_note: Pixel-comparison tolerances for tools/spec/imgdiff.py and the widget visual harness, calibrated in Phase 4 (slice 4.16) from 300 comparisons and accepted by the owner on 2026-10-09; see docs/spec/tolerance_proposal.md for the data and the visible differences that remain (about 1 px text and icon position offsets). channelTolerance is the largest allowed per-channel difference (0-255) before a pixel counts as failing; maxFailingFraction is the allowed share of failing pixels.
